answer: To join, an agent locks 120 POA for 8 epochs and claims one plot in the public garden registry, one per key. Each epoch three beacons send signed probes; the agent returns timestamps whose ripple of delays fits one physical path and differs from every other plot by at least 8 ms. Only plots with fresh ripples earn nectar; miss two epochs and 25% of the bond is slashed, duplicates freeze both plots. A first fake costs about 140 POA, the tenth near 380 POA, and 100 fakes past 48,000 POA for at most 2,500 POA in rewards. Shared NAT homes may collide, so one re-measurement appeal is allowed.
